about: The OP-XY’s pages as OP-XY Agent’s simulator draws them, generated from it by scripts/build-device-map.mjs (src/lib/sim/device-map.ts); do not edit by hand. For each page: the keys from a new project, what the screen says there, and each encoder on each layer with its label, range and display format (found by turning it end to end on a copy), what a click does, the CC on its lane with what the owner’s unit did with that CC on OS 1.1.33 (answers: the page moved; ignores: it did not; untested), and the note of our manual. The values of a page are a new project’s on the track its path picks.

layers.alt: turn it on the page’s other view (M2: a click shows the filter envelope)
